  "decision-export-corrected-appliance-inventory": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT asset_id, label_text, rated_w,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_id ORDER BY revision_no DESC) AS rn
  FROM asset_revision
)
SELECT 'asset_id,label,rated_w' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_text
FROM (
  SELECT asset_id || ',"' || replace(label_text, '"', '""') || '",' || rated_w || char(10) AS line
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1 AND rated_w IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY asset_id COLLATE BINARY
);",
  "decision-export-evidence-backed-accrual-adjustments": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT work_code, source_id, measured_units,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY work_code ORDER BY signed_on DESC, revision_no DESC) AS rn
  FROM field_certificate
  WHERE signed_on <= '2026-09-30'
), adjustments AS (
  SELECT r.work_code, r.source_id, r.measured_units * a.rate_cents - a.booked_cents AS adjustment_cents
  FROM ranked AS r
  JOIN work_account AS a ON a.work_code = r.work_code
  WHERE r.rn = 1
)
SELECT 'work_code,source_id,adjustment_cents' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_content
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(work_code, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(source_id, '"', '""') || '",' || adjustment_cents || char(10) AS line
  FROM adjustments
  WHERE adjustment_cents <> 0
  ORDER BY work_code COLLATE BINARY
);",
  "decision-export-page-specific-caption-errata": "SELECT 'page,panel,caption,source_id' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT p.page_num || ',"' || replace(p.panel_code, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(c.intended_caption, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(c.source_id, '"', '""') || '"' || char(10) AS line
  FROM printed_panel AS p
  JOIN mount_card AS c ON c.page_num = p.page_num AND c.panel_code = p.panel_code
  WHERE c.intended_caption IS NOT NULL AND c.intended_caption COLLATE BINARY <> p.printed_caption
  ORDER BY p.page_num, p.panel_code COLLATE BINARY
);",
  "decision-export-paired-counter-exceptions": "WITH paired AS (
  SELECT burst_tag,
         MAX(CASE WHEN counter_kind = 'incumbent' THEN parcel_count END) AS incumbent,
         MAX(CASE WHEN counter_kind = 'shadow' THEN parcel_count END) AS shadow
  FROM counter_reports
  GROUP BY burst_tag
)
SELECT 'burst,incumbent,shadow' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_contents
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(burst_tag, '"', '""') || '",' || COALESCE(incumbent, '') || ',' || COALESCE(shadow, '') || char(10) AS line
  FROM paired
  WHERE incumbent IS NULL OR shadow IS NULL OR incumbent <> shadow
  ORDER BY burst_tag COLLATE BINARY
);"
}
